notes.title: 20% Off Trouble in Tornado Town for the Steam Winter Sale!
notes.content:
This winter, chaos is in the air! 
Trouble in Tornado Town is 20% off during the Steam Winter Sale. Control a tornado, tear through towns, and leave a trail of destruction—all while saving big. Make this whirlwind adventure a part of your holiday gaming collection!

notes.title: Leaderboards, Laboratories, and... Lockjaw?!
notes.content:
Hey! It's been a while!

Today marks the official release of the 4th Trouble in Tornado Town level, Abducted Laboratories!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184046/fd060fd119b1f0d2b799fdcf7cc02f3149fb8c8b.gif

That's not all! Speedrun the game's levels and show up on the new leaderboards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184046/30293fbf4244ecdc0d2c8c2f1aa03df401cce225.gif

BONUS
You read this all the way through? Nice. Wishlist our new game, Lockjaw: Robo-Royale, coming out soon! There's also a free demo (which we'll update very soon).

notes.title: This New Update is BANANAS! (Get it?) ((Bananas?)) (((Like Abducted Monkeys?)))
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! The Monkeys have been working hard to bring you some exciting news!

There are some among us who have a need for speed, and we have a playtest just for you!

Test the Global Leaderboards coming to Trouble in Tornado Town!

Compete with your friends to get the fastest time possible and have a shot at holding the world record!


For those of you who have been begging for wacky destruction on the go, we have great news!

Trouble in Tornado Town is now compatible with the Steam Deck! 

Take your favorite destruction game to wherever you may blow, with the ability to play wherever your heart desires. Who knows where you might complete your quickest run?


For our Mac enthusiasts out there, don't think we forgot about you!

Trouble in Tornado Town is releasing on Mac as well!


No matter what platform you prefer, you can tear up the town!

Stay tuned for more updates coming very soon, as the Monkeys have been hard at work to bring you a brand new level!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184046/ac77a8ee60ab96e3006fd5f73219e25e6efc1a07.gif

Here's the patch notes in more detail:

 Trouble in Tornado Town is now available on Mac!
 Try our new Steam leaderboard feature in our free Steam Playtest! See our post on TikTok about it!
 Changed level order to make the experience better for new players
 Changed start point in Breezy Fields
 Propane tanks now explode!
 Updated entries in the Credits
 Fixed a bug where the game would only run at its normal framerate after pausing


Until next time!
- The Abducted Monkeys Team

notes.title: Controllers, Sound Improvements, Bug Fixes, Oh My!
notes.content:
Long time no see!

Our monkeys have prepared a big update for you!
We've (banana) split our recent development time into a mix of quality-of-life fixes, better sound implementation, and...

*drum roll please*

Trouble in Tornado Town is now playable on controllers! 

In case you were curious, here's the full list of features and changes we've made:


 Added full controller support!
 Updated farm animal SFX on Breezy Fields
 Human screams are now more varied ;)
 Fixed a bug where incorrect graphics quality would show when viewing settings inside a level
 Decreased the time between news headlines
 Updated/fixed credits and attributions
 Added Retry button to the menu that shows up after completing a main objective (this should help out speedrunners!)


We're excited to see everyone enjoy this update! Be sure to spread the word!

See you on the speedrun forums!
- The Abducted Monkeys Team

P.S. If you are experiencing any controller issues, check out our controller fixes thread

notes.title: February 2023 - Upcoming Content
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just wanted to give a brief update on our recent progress with Tornado Town. Hope you’ve loved playing it so far!

First off, we’ve set up a speedrun.com community for the game! Submit your best times for each level, and go for the world record!

Next, we’re working on getting the game ready for Mac players! Before our Mac release, we plan on releasing a small patch that fixes bugs and adds some quality-of-life changes to the game. Look forward to seeing that soon.

Additionally, we are hard at work on getting controller support ready for the game.

Lastly, 

Deep within the bowels of Abducted Laboratories, scientists have been experimenting on a new kind of controllable, man-made tornado. Surely nothing can go wrong...
Our newest level, Abducted Laboratories, is coming soon to a computer near you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184046/30410cb1d3011e7c59c96ff4fae2cff977fc99e4.gif

Until next time!
- The Abducted Monkeys Team
